issues.issue: What standard of review and scope apply to the RAD appeal
issues.applicant_position: RAD should independently assess the evidence and decide the merits of the refugee claims.
issues.result_text: RAD defers to RPD on advantage-based findings; it shows no deference where the RPD had no advantage.

issues.issue: Whether new evidence is admissible under IRPA s.110(4), and the role of the Raza factors
issues.applicant_position: Raza's materiality test is too restrictive; RAD should admit new evidence showing RPD error.
issues.result_text: RAD will apply credibility, relevance and materiality factors to new evidence that passes section 110(4).

issues.issue: Whether letters (a) to (e) are admissible new evidence
issues.applicant_position: Letters arose after rejection and were not available earlier; the Appellants could not give them to the RPD.
issues.result_text: Letters (a) to (e) did not arise after rejection and were reasonably available; they fail section 110(4).

issues.issue: Whether the landlord's letter (f) is admissible new evidence
issues.applicant_position: The landlord's letter was requested after the hearing and received only after the negative decision.
issues.result_text: Letter lacks credibility due to misspellings and missing attachments; it would not be admitted or weighted.

issues.issue: Whether letters (g) and (i) and the photographs (h) are admissible new evidence
issues.applicant_position: Letter (i) was not given to the RPD as the Appellants were unaware it was relevant; photos were obtained only after the decision.
issues.result_text: Photos and letters are not admissible under section 110(4) and are not material; they cannot affect the outcome.

issues.issue: Whether the RPD had to make a clear finding on sexual orientation and consider section 97(1) risk
issues.applicant_position: The RPD failed to make a clear finding on sexual orientation, so it had to consider section 97(1) risk.
issues.result_text: Appellants failed to establish credible evidence of sexual minority status, so no section 97 analysis was required.

issues.issue: Whether the RAD may disturb the RPD's credibility findings
issues.result_text: No basis for appellate intervention on credibility findings; no errors pointed out.

issues.issue: Whether an oral hearing should be held before the RAD
issues.applicant_position: Appellants request an oral hearing before the RAD.
issues.result_text: Oral hearing refused because no new evidence was admitted.
